title: Salted password hashing via werkzeug generate_password_hash / check_password_hash
description: Passwords are never stored in plaintext. Registration uses werkzeug.security.generate_password_hash(password) to store a salted, modern-KDF hash. Login uses check_password_hash(user['password'], password) to verify. This is a verified security control that must not regress.
spec:
1. Verify flaskr/auth.py imports generate_password_hash and check_password_hash from werkzeug.security.
2. Verify register() stores generate_password_hash(password) — not plaintext — in the user.password column.
3. Verify login() verifies the submitted password via check_password_hash(user['password'], password).
4. Verify tests/data.sql stores only hashed passwords (pbkdf2:sha256 format), never plaintext.
5. Verify no raw password is ever stored or logged.
